method: Arithmetic mean of ten annual EUR/USD averages; each year has equal weight. Other directions are inverse/cross rates derived from this common base, not independently averaged. Historical indicative rates, not current market or retail exchange rates.
rounding: Nearest cent for EUR/USD; nearest whole franc for XOF/XAF; ties away from zero. Each amount is rounded once. The opening balance reconciles the ledger to the directly converted current balance. Values that would vanish or exceed storage limits block the entire conversion.
